title: Merchandise Purchases Price Adjustment Terms by Merchandise Class
content:
These are the class terms on which a lower Marlowe & Finch price is refunded on a **Merchandise Purchases** unit as a price adjustment.

| Merchandise class | Price adjustment available | Adjustment window (calendar days after the purchase date) | Most price adjustments one purchase record can receive | Smallest per-unit difference refunded |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Apparel, Shoes & Accessories | Yes | 14 | 2 | $1.00 |
| Beauty & Fragrance | Yes | 14 | 2 | $1.00 |
| Home & Kitchen | Yes | 14 | 2 | $1.00 |
| Electronics & Small Appliances | Yes | 14 | 1 | $1.00 |
| Fine Jewelry & Watches | Yes | 7 | 1 | $1.00 |
| Designer Handbags & Luxury | No | not applicable | not applicable | $1.00 |
| Furniture & Mattresses | Yes | 30 | 1 | $1.00 |

**Lower prices that never qualify (every class):** clearance markdowns, doorbusters, coupons or promo codes, competitor prices, final sale prices and bonus card offers.

**Where an adjustment is refunded (every class):** to the original tender.

### Points of reading

- Designer Handbags & Luxury units receive no price adjustment; the window and the per-item limit have no value for that class.
- Hypothetical: a Home & Kitchen unit may receive up to two adjustments, an Electronics & Small Appliances unit only one.
- Hypothetical: a lower price that differs from the price paid by $0.99 is below the $1.00 smallest difference; a difference of exactly $1.00 meets it.
